title: RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LTD -- Interpretive Commentary
body: ROIC sits just below the WACC of 10.73%, suggesting returns are only marginally covering the cost of capital. EBITDA margin remains strong at 19.70% and has been stable over the last three years, while net margin of 7.65% indicates efficient bottom‑line performance. Sales growth of 9.65% for 2026 and a 14.84% 3‑year CAGR point to continued expansion. Forecasted sales for 2027–2029 are 1.13M, 1.21M, and 1.29M, respectively, implying a 7.5% CAGR, and EBITDA margin is expected to stay in the 19.0–19.7% range. The DCF model values equity at 1,107.18 per share, slightly below the current price of 1,226, implying the stock is trading at a modest premium. Cost of equity is 12.27% and post‑tax cost of debt is 5.63%, with an adjusted beta of 1.08. Monte‑Carlo VAR shows the 8th percentile price at 1,201.68, a 1.98% downside risk.
